FK.inboundMetricLabel: Personal / leisure overnight tourist arrivals by country of residence
FK.inboundScope: Falkland Islands; personal-purpose overnight tourists only
FK.inboundNote: Eight named markets with exact counts reported on pages 8–9. This is not a complete Top 8: Australia appears only as a rounded chart share and cannot be ranked exactly here. Personal travel includes holidays and visiting friends/relatives; business tourists and cruise day visitors are excluded. All personal arrivals: 2,918; all overnight tourists including business: 4,818. Counts are historical, not Nov–Dec 2026 forecasts.
FK.label: Falkland Islands Tourist Board · 2025 leisure arrivals
FK.note: Market counts use the territory's own tourism report, not United Kingdom totals. No resident outbound destination ranking was verified.

AW.outboundMetricLabel: Resident outbound travelers by main destination
AW.outboundScope: Aruba resident outbound travel; main destination counts, IASA administrative universe
AW.outboundNote: Table 2.1, page 4: nine individually reported destinations with numeric 2022 values, plus Other 330; total 81,798. Venezuela is a dash and is omitted rather than treated as zero. Bonaire is the island only, linked to BQ for navigation. This table's source is Instituto Alarma y Seguridad Aruba; the expenditure/characteristics survey's April–December 2022 limitation is separate. These are travel movements, not a deduplicated count of residents or a 2026 projection.
AW.label: CBS Aruba · resident outbound travel 2022
AW.note: Historical local resident outbound counts; the source publishes fewer than 20 named destinations. Inbound figures, where available elsewhere, use a different series.

FO.inboundMetricLabel: Hotel guest nights by country of residence
FO.inboundScope: Reporting hotels in the Faroe Islands, excluding Suðuroy
FO.inboundNote: Denmark is the only foreign country individually reported in this official residence breakdown. Other countries together: 113,472 guest nights; Faroese residents: 54,759; all residence groups: 230,434. Therefore this is not a one-country ranking of all foreign demand, nor a Top 20. Nights are not unique tourists, and Faroese domestic nights are excluded from the inbound market row. Historical 2024 figures are not November–December 2026 forecasts.
FO.label: Statistics Faroe Islands · hotel guest nights
FO.note: Official local accommodation series. Danish national travel totals are not assigned to the Faroes; no resident outbound destination table was verified.

researchNotes.note: CBS publishes 2009–2025 stayover arrivals by residence as an XLSX download. Its download returned a browser JavaScript challenge to this research client, so no unverified 2025 counts were transcribed.

Arrivals and departures workbook exists, but passenger counts are not a country market ranking. Government notes changed immigration procedures and missing 2025 purpose/resident classifications. St Helena island statistics are not all SH territory.
Eight exact market counts are available in the 2025 leisure-arrivals table and narrative. Country chart percentages were not converted to invented counts; other countries remain grouped.
